cases.name: Amzu, Swarm's Hunger
cases.text: Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, you may create a 1/1 black and green Insect creature token, then put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the greatest mana value among those cards. Do this only once each turn.

cases.name: G'raha Tia, Scion Reborn
cases.text: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may pay X life, where X is that spell's mana value. If you do, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token and put X +1/+1 counters on it. Do this only once each turn.

cases.name: Kharasha Foothills

cases.name: Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

cases.text:
Flying, menace
Other Insects you control have menace.
Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard, you may create a 2/2 black and green Insect creature token, then put a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the greatest mana value among those cards. Do this only once each turn.

cases.name: Kharasha Foothills
cases.text:
Whenever a creature you control attacks a player, for each other opponent, you may create a token that's a copy of that creature, tapped and attacking that opponent. Exile those tokens at the beginning of the next end step.
Whenever chaos ensues, you may sacrifice any number of artifacts. If you do, Kharasha Foothills deals that much damage to target creature.
